title: Admin API: GeneralFaqCategory CRUD
content:
一般 FAQ 分類的管理端 CRUD API，均需 admin role 驗證。

Zod schemas (在 src/lib/validation/faq.ts)：
- generalFaqCategoryCreateSchema：nameZh, nameEn, nameZhCn?, order?
- generalFaqCategoryUpdateSchema：partial() of create schema

Routes：
- GET /api/admin/faq/categories — 回傳所有分類，依 order 排序
- POST /api/admin/faq/categories — 建立分類，Zod 驗證，回 400 on invalid
- PATCH /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] — 更新分類，Zod partial 驗證
- DELETE /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] — 刪除分類，cascade 刪除旗下 FAQs（onDelete: Cascade）

Pattern（依既有慣例）：
- auth() 檢查 session.user.role === 'ADMIN'，否則 403
- Zod safeParse → 400 with flatten().fieldErrors
- try/catch → console.error → 500
- Next.js 16 params: Promise pattern
acceptance: GET /api/admin/faq/categories returns all categories ordered by `order`
POST /api/admin/faq/categories creates category with Zod validation, returns 400 on invalid input
PATCH /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] updates category, returns 404 if not found
DELETE /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] deletes category and cascades FAQs
All routes return 401 without auth, 403 for non-admin users
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && curl with valid admin token: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE categories
